items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: That's Henry Davison. That's the devil I can't say his name.

ctx.x: Well, you see this band is mixed up. That's Corpus Christi and St. Catharine mixed together. That's Henry Davison. That's the devil I can't say his name. This other band is from Texas. That's Garnier. I know you heard of him.
No, no. That's from New Orleans.
